title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**Hawaii Doors and Windows** is looking for an experienced and proactive **Talent Acquisition Specialist** to lead full-cycle recruitment, partner closely with department heads, and create strong talent pipelines to support our company's scaling goals.

* **End-to-End Recruitment:** Manage the full hiring lifecycle, including requirement gathering, job posting, sourcing, interviewing, reference checks, background checks, wage/compensation negotiation, and offer rollouts.
* **Multi-Function Hiring:** Hire for specialized roles unique to the doors and windows industry, such as **Retail Showroom leaders,** **Sales & Marketing representatives**, **window & door installers, service coordinators, technicians, and other key positions.**
* **Regional Sourcing:** Source active and passive candidates through job boards, industry networks, local trade schools, direct headhunting, and employee referral programs.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Partner closely with Business Partners, Regional Sales Heads and Department Leads to understand manpower needs and business expansion plans.
* **Candidate Experience & Employer Branding:** Ensure a smooth, timely, and positive interview experience for all candidates while promoting the company as an employer of choice in the building materials sector.
* **Recruitment Metrics & Compliance:** Track key hiring metrics such as Time-to-Hire, Cost-per-Hire, and Offer-to-Join ratio. Maintain accurate applicant tracking records and ensure adherence to company HR policies.

**Qualification Requirement:** Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. An MBA/PGDM in HR is preferred.

**Experience:** 2 to 3 years of experience in talent acquisition, preferably within the **building materials, fenestration, interior fit-out, construction, or manufacturing** industries.

**Sourcing Expertise:** Hands-on experience with Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, Job portals, and blue-collar/field-level hiring strategies.

**Language Proficiency:** Fluency in **English** is mandatory. Working proficiency in at least two South Indian languages (**Tamil & Malayalam**) is strongly preferred to effectively engage with regional candidates and site staff.

**Communication & Negotiation:** Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to negotiate compensation packages and manage expectations across different organizational levels.

title: Client Service – Intern
description:
At impress.ai our mission is to make accurate hiring easier. We combine I/O Psychology with AI to create application screening processes that allow each and every candidate to undergo a structured interview. While candidates benefit from the enhanced experience, recruiters benefit from the AI-enabled automation. Launched in 2017, impress.ai (registered as ideatory Pte. Ltd.) is a no-code, self-service platform that is highly focused on simplifying and accelerating various parts of the recruitment workflow. Its co-founders observed problems in hiring processes at several companies before even starting impress.ai. They noticed challenges in candidate experience as well as recruiters having a tough time with a large scale of hiring, the variety of roles, and handling various systems. After immense research, they found a solution in the power of AI and intelligent automation.

**The Job:**

We are looking for a Client Service Intern to join our support team at impress.ai. In this role, you will assist in handling client and candidate queries related to the platform, learn how to resolve issues efficiently, and gain hands-on experience in customer support operations.

You will work alongside experienced team members while supporting impress.ai’s growing global client base across regions such as the US, Singapore, and India. This internship offers strong learning opportunities, real-world exposure, and the potential for growth for interns who perform well.

**Responsibilities:**

* Be part of the client service team that does the following tasks:
* Support the team in handling client and candidate queries related to the impress.ai platform, aiming to resolve them within defined SLAs.
* Assist in identifying, tracking, escalating, and following up on issues to ensure timely resolution.
* Help document support queries, solutions, and workflows for internal knowledge bases.
* Provide feedback and suggestions to improve candidate support processes.
* Assist Operations Analysts with documentation, reporting, and day-to-day operational tasks.
* Collaborate with internal teams to address client and candidate needs effectively.
* Perform basic troubleshooting for technical issues under team guidance.
* Analyze support queries to identify patterns and opportunities for process or product improvements.
* Help maintain accurate records of client interactions and updates in tools like Confluence.

**You Bring to the Table:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft or Google tools (Excel/Sheets, Word/Docs, PowerPoint/Slides).
* Background in Computer Engineering, IT, or related fields is a plus.
* Prior internship, academic project, or part-time experience in client support or operations preferred.
* Basic familiarity with ticketing tools (e.g., JIRA) or CRM systems (e.g., Freshdesk) is an advantage.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
* Detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable working both independently and in teams.
* Willingness to learn, commit to the internship duration, and work flexible hours if needed.

**Our Benefits:**

* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies such as Machine Learning, AI, and NLP, and learn from experienced professionals in a fast-growing international SaaS start-up.
* Exposure to a strong culture of learning and development through team discussions, brown bag sessions, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* A supportive environment where you can build real-world skills, take ownership of tasks, and grow as a trusted team member.
* Hands-on experience contributing to a fast-growing, market-leading product.
* A culture that values both meaningful work and personal well-being, promoting a healthy balance.
* Internship Details:

This is an internship focused on practical learning, mentorship, and industry exposure. High-performing interns may be considered for full-time opportunities based on performance, business needs, and role availability.

Diversity and Inclusion are more than just words for us. We are committed to providing a respectful, safe, and inclusive workplace. Diversity at impress.ai means fostering a workplace in which individual differences are recognized, appreciated, and respected in ways that fully develop and utilize each person’s talents and strengths. We pride ourselves on working with the best and we know our company runs on the hard work and dedication of our talented team members.

description:
Senior Recruiter – Job Description

**Job Title:** Senior Recruiter  
**Department:** Human Resources / Talent Acquisition  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Reports To:** Talent Acquisition Manager / HR Head

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Senior Recruiter to manage end-to-end recruitment activities and drive talent acquisition strategies. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in sourcing, screening, interviewing, stakeholder management, and closing candidates across various functions.

The Senior Recruiter will play a key role in understanding manpower requirements, building talent pipelines, ensuring a positive candidate experience, and delivering quality hires within defined timelines.

Key Responsibilities1. End-to-End Recruitment

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from understanding job requirements to offer rollout and onboarding.
* Handle mid-level, senior-level, and leadership hiring across various departments.
* Develop effective recruitment strategies to meet business hiring requirements.
* Ensure timely closure of open positions within agreed recruitment timelines.

2. Candidate Sourcing & Screening

* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, social media, employee referrals, consultants, and other channels.
* Build and maintain a strong database of qualified candidates.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial HR interviews to evaluate candidate suitability.
* Assess candidates based on skills, experience, qualifications, and cultural fit.

3. Stakeholder Management

* Work closely with hiring managers and department heads to understand manpower requirements.
* Conduct detailed requirement briefing sessions and define candidate selection criteria.
* Coordinate interview schedules and collect timely feedback from interview panels.
* Provide regular updates on recruitment progress and hiring challenges.

4. Interview & Offer Management

* Coordinate technical and managerial interview rounds.
* Manage salary negotiations and offer discussions.
* Ensure successful offer conversion and minimize candidate dropouts.
* Conduct reference checks and coordinate pre-employment documentation.

5. Recruitment Analytics & Reporting

* Maintain recruitment trackers, candidate databases, and hiring reports.
* Monitor recruitment KPIs, including:
* Time to hire
* Cost per hire
* Offer-to-joining ratio
* Source effectiveness
* Position closure rate
* Prepare weekly and monthly recruitment reports.
* Identify opportunities to improve recruitment processes and efficiency.

6. Employer Branding & Process Improvement

* Support employer branding and talent attraction initiatives.
* Enhance candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.
* Develop innovative sourcing strategies to attract top talent.
* Stay updated on industry trends, talent market conditions, and recruitment best practices.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* MBA / PGDM in HR will be an added advantage
